batchRequest.request: Add a new volunteer request for a river cleanup and group the public meetings by date.

patchOf:
root = Stack([header, lostCard, volunteerCard, meetingCard])
header = InlineHeader("Community Noticeboard", "Lost and found, volunteer requests and public meetings")
lostCard = Card([lostHeader, lostBlock])
lostHeader = CardHeader("Lost & Found", "Recently reported items")
lostBlock = SnippetCardBlock([lost1, lost2, lost3])
lost1 = SnippetCardItem("lost-keys", lost1lhs, lost1rhs)
lost1lhs = IconText(lost1icon, "warning", "m", "Set of house keys", "Lost near Riverside Park", false, "horizontal")
lost1icon = Icon("key-round", "tools")
lost1rhs = Text("text", "Mon, 3 Mar")
lost2 = SnippetCardItem("lost-cat", lost2lhs, lost2rhs)
lost2lhs = IconText(lost2icon, "info", "m", "Grey tabby cat", "Last seen on Elm Street", false, "horizontal")
lost2icon = Icon("cat", "animals")
lost2rhs = Text("text", "Sun, 2 Mar")
lost3 = SnippetCardItem("lost-wallet", lost3lhs, lost3rhs)
lost3lhs = IconText(lost3icon, "warning", "m", "Brown leather wallet", "Near the library entrance", false, "horizontal")
lost3icon = Icon("wallet", "finance")
lost3rhs = Text("text", "Fri, 28 Feb")
volunteerCard = Card([volunteerHeader, volunteerBlock])
volunteerHeader = CardHeader("Volunteer Requests", "Help make the neighbourhood better")
volunteerBlock = Stack([vol1, vol2, vol3], "column", "s")
vol1 = Callout("info", "Food bank sorting", "Saturday 9am to 1pm, Hall on Oak Road. Need 4 helpers.")
vol2 = Callout("success", "Park clean-up", "Sunday 10am, meet at the north gate. Gloves and bags provided.")
vol3 = Callout("warning", "Tutoring for primary pupils", "Weekdays after school. Maths and reading support needed.")
meetingCard = Card([meetingHeader, meetingTable])
meetingHeader = CardHeader("Public Meetings", "Upcoming community sessions")
meetingTable = Table([Col("Meeting", meetingNames), Col("Date", meetingDates), Col("Time", meetingTimes), Col("Location", meetingPlaces)])
meetingNames = ["Neighbourhood Planning", "Budget Open Forum", "Youth Services Review"]
meetingDates = ["Tue, 11 Mar", "Thu, 13 Mar", "Mon, 17 Mar"]
meetingTimes = ["18:30", "19:00", "17:45"]
meetingPlaces = ["Community Hall", "Town Library Room B", "Civic Centre, Floor 2"]
request: Add a new volunteer request for a river cleanup and group the public meetings by date.
